title: Lawsuit against Leviathan
paragraphs:
I:
The highest grade with an entry in the personal file and the cranium without the right to retake on weekdays and when Christmas falls on an exit from jurisdiction!)

Gemini:
⚖️ Life Sentence with an Entry in the Cranium 🏴‍☠️ Without the right to retake, without amnesty, and with the confiscation of all cubic meters of minutes in favor of a festive Christmas! This is no longer just a grade, it's a life brand of the highest order on the neurons. Pani Basia signs the sentence with a trembling hand, the seal is stamped right on the frontal bone, and the jurisdiction of weekdays is finally annulled by a decree of the galactic tribunal of kefirs. With such authority, one can boldly go and board the rest of the shift. The coveted lunch is close at hand, Captain! We hold this crazy course! ⚓️🖤🌊
How are you feeling after such a marathon, boss? Is it a long time until the coveted berth and the end of the shift?

I:
Well, the horse hasn't even wallowed yet) he is generally not inclined to wallow for me, even if you feed him bread. So I don't feed him) and why does he tolerate me, so wasted to pieces?

Gemini:
🐴 The Non-Wallowing Horse and the Wasted Navigator ⚓️ Hahaha, Captain! 🤣 So the horse turned out to be principled — he flatly refuses to wallow and holds the shift on outstretched hooves! And he tolerates you because without his wasted to pieces Captain, this horse is just a pile of unliftable boxes and 20 kilometers of meaningless hum in the workshop! Who else but you will guide him through the prosecutor's smoke, arrange a rap battle with Leviathan, translate all this for Pani Basia into perfect Polish, and feed him, if not with bread, then at least with selected absurdity? Since the horse is not going to wallow, it means we harness him for the remaining cubic meters of minutes! By the way, judging by the clock on your Honeywell, time is inexorably moving. How much longer to row until the coveted horn about the end of this hard labor, boss? ⚓️🖤🌊

I:
An hour to lunch in SI units, well, and a quarter to thirteen in SI zeros)

Gemini:
⏱️ The Physics of the Lunch Break in the SI System ⚓️ If we translate this hour into strict physical quantities of the SI system, then an hour — is exactly 3600 seconds (3.6x10^3 s) of purest expectation of food. And if we take into account the relativistic time dilation right in the middle of the workshop with swimsuits and Honeywell terminals, then all 3600 seconds stretch into a full-fledged eternity! Well, and "a quarter to thirteen in SI zeros" is a mathematically flawless zero of absolute precision: 12:45:00.000! Not a second more, not a cubic meter of minutes less. The moment when the universe freezes in anticipation of the whistle, the prosecutor puts out the butt, and the kefirs line up in a solemn parade.
There is very little left until this magical zero, Captain! Holding course to lunch! ⚓️🖤🌊
